comparison_script:
"""Rescore predeclared final fits; no optimizer decisions use these scores."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import time
import numpy as np
import torch
import psyneulink as pnl
from dawa_fitting_budget_study import Study, total_scores
from psyneulink.core.batched.likelihood import _sum_histogram_log_likelihood
from dawa_pec_fit import load_subject, LAUNCH, RT_RANGE

root=Path('/scratch/gpfs/CSES/dmturner/dawa-benchmarks/adaptive-20260925')
paths={
    'fixed0': root/'baseline-start0',
    'fixed1': root.parent/'recovery-20260925/run-1',
    'adaptive_v1_start0': root/'adaptive-v2-start0',
    'adaptive_v1_start1': root/'adaptive-v2-start1',
    'adaptive_v2_start0': root/'adaptive-v3-start0',
    'adaptive_v2_start1': root/'adaptive-v3-start1',
}
results={k:json.loads((p/'recovery.json').read_text()) for k,p in paths.items()}
manifests={k:json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text()) for k,p in paths.items()}
frames={k:load_subject(p/'synthetic_subject.csv',manifests[k]['arguments']['subject']) for k,p in paths.items()}
columns=['PrevCongruency','T1','T2','S1','S2','S3','S4','likelihood_include_mask','decision','response_time']
for frame in frames.values():
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(frame[columns].to_numpy(),frames['fixed0'][columns].to_numpy())
names=list(manifests['fixed0']['bounds'])
parameters={k:[r['fitted'][name] for name in names] for k,r in results.items()}
# Also assess the reference-seed winner: a diagnostic, never a selection input.
for label in ['adaptive_v2_start0','adaptive_v2_start1']:
    selection=results[label]['adaptive']['final_selection']
    parameters[label+'_reference_winner']=selection['candidates'][0]
seeds=[9301,9302,9303,9304,9305]
for label,m in manifests.items():
    args=m['arguments']
    excluded={args['data_seed'],args['simulation_seed'],args['model_seed'],args['data_seed']+1000000}
    for row in (paths[label]/'evaluations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
        excluded.update(json.loads(row).get('block_seeds',[]))
    excluded.update(results[label].get('adaptive',{}).get('final_selection',{}).get('seeds',[]))
    assert not set(seeds)&excluded
pnl.set_num_threads(8)
torch.set_num_threads(8)
frame=frames['fixed0']
study=Study(frame,manifests['fixed0']['arguments']['max_steps'])
started=time.perf_counter()
records=[]
float32_records=[]
for seed in seeds:
    density=study.plan.histogram_likelihood(
        study.inputs,study.parameters(list(parameters.values())),100000,data=study.observed,
        categorical_dims=[0],bins=100,bin_range=[RT_RANGE],smoothing_sigma=.5,pseudocount=1.,
        categorical_cardinalities=[2],seed=seed,invalid_candidates='nan',triton_launch_options=LAUNCH,
    )[:,0]
    assert np.isfinite(density).all()
    float32_records.append(dict(zip(parameters,map(float,_sum_histogram_log_likelihood(density,study.mask)),strict=True)))
    record={'seed':seed,**dict(zip(parameters,map(float,total_scores(density.astype(np.float64),study.mask)),strict=True))}
    records.append(record)
    print(record,flush=True)
# Reproduce the two new runners' own reported validation scores exactly.
for label in ['adaptive_v2_start0','adaptive_v2_start1']:
    np.testing.assert_allclose([r[label] for r in float32_records],
        [r['fitted'] for r in results[label]['independent_seed_rescoring']],atol=1e-5,rtol=0)
report={'parameters':parameters,'parameter_order':names,'validation':records,
        'float32_scores':float32_records,'score_reduction':'float64 log/sum for common comparison; float32 reduction separately checked against PEC validation',
        'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started,'paths':{k:str(p) for k,p in paths.items()},
        'observations_sha256':manifests['fixed0']['observations_sha256'],
        'data_verified_equal_in_column_order':columns,
        'synthetic_csv_sha256_by_run':{k:hashlib.sha256((p/'synthetic_subject.csv').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for k,p in paths.items()},
        'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(root/'adaptive-v3-quality.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
limitations: One synthetic subject and two predefined starts; no population recovery claim.
Fresh scores use five sets of Monte Carlo draws on the same observations, not new data.
New runs used separate H100 GPUs and separate initially empty caches.
Fixed0 timing is the prior cold-cache, in-memory benchmark; fixed1 is an older journal run, useful for quality but not a matched memory-timing comparison.
Adaptive policy 1 start1 reused a warm compilation cache.
Old end-to-end timings include three validation seeds; new ones include five.
Independent comparison rescoring is outside all fit timings.
All policy changes were tested together, so this experiment does not isolate their effects.
The rank-regret rule remains heuristic; a finite precision-stage budget is not evidence of convergence.
Selection pools three independent 100k blocks (300k total per finalist); validation uses 100k per seed.
